purpose: Research scenarios for native subscription decisions; not runtime prices, account-specific fee verification, or actual customer/profit data.
policyBasis: Published Apple EU and Play US schedules announced for 2026-10-01; eligibility and accepted agreements must be rechecked before implementation.
limits: 25% VAT is an inclusive Croatian example, not an EU-wide or US rate. Set zero tax and inclusive/exclusive treatment deliberately for another comparison.
International cards means cards issued outside the EEA/UK for an assumed Croatian Stripe account; it does not assume a US merchant account or convert prices to USD.
US iOS external platform fee of zero is an editable sensitivity only. A final commission schedule was not verified. Recheck actual terms and court-driven updates.
Store commission is modeled on tax-exclusive original sales, with configurable refund credits. Google reporting/invoice treatment needs confirmation.
Refunds reverse sales and transaction tax proportionally. Fee refund credits are conservative model inputs, not promises of contract treatment. Disputes and additional taxes need expense inputs.
RevenueCat fee uses gross tracked payments before refunds in this conservative model. Confirm invoice adjustments and exact threshold treatment. Annual payments count fully in the charge month.
USD per EUR of 1 is an illustrative threshold conversion, not a market quote. Replace it before interpreting RevenueCat threshold results for actual EUR transactions.
The 1,000-payment example is illustrative, not an actual customer count. Cost and recognized-revenue inputs remain missing so contribution and operating profit cannot appear as known facts.
Annual cash receipts are not monthly recognized revenue. The operating-profit section requires explicitly supplied recognition and expense amounts.
Actual Stripe Price tax_behavior, merchant country, custom contracts, Small Business enrollment and store price points have not been inspected.
